_about: William Jenkyn (1613-1685), ejected minister of Christ Church, Newgate: An Exposition of the Epistle of Jude, revised by James Sherman, bound with Jean Daillé's expositions of Philippians and Colossians (Edinburgh: Nichol; London: Nisbet, 1865). The name check is on Jenkyn; Daillé's part is held here because it is the same volume. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
